_comment: Operator-maintained release notes, keyed by versionName. generate-release-manifest.mjs copies the entry for a version into src/data/release.json. Leave a version out to show 'release notes not available'. Do not add claims a release cannot support.
1.0.1: Updates are delivered only through the official Chikondi website.
More reliable notification delivery, including when your phone is optimising battery.
Android update integrity hardened with the APK Signature Scheme v3.
